overall.candidate_field_strategy: For each scheduled query, union P in Title, Keywords, and Abstract. Where its upper bound exceeds 100, use the P-by-defining-block 3-by-3 union and leave the third semantic block in Anywhere. Split only T2 OR alternatives where the unsplit field row failed.
blockers: No verified known eligible AIAA sentinel demonstrates that metadata-only P/defining-block placement has no observed recall loss versus Anywhere.
A2 and BT2 remain visibly noisy because required Anywhere blocks often lack visible metadata evidence and may occur only in hidden indexed content or full text.
ARC has no language limiter. Type facets cannot be shown to be lossless. Topic semantics are insufficient for a safe noise filter.
